name: Jahangir
contribution: He backed Islam Khan's Bengal campaigns and the shift of the provincial capital to Dhaka (Jahangirnagar).
context: Under his reign, Mughal strategy moved from partial occupation toward territorial consolidation in Bengal.
impact: His period set the administrative framework for durable Mughal rule in eastern Bengal.
highlight: Jahangir's reign anchored the Dhaka-centered consolidation phase in Bengal.
